entries.note: Pointer focus selects a view without changing its root/session binding. Toolbar focus clears custom editor/terminal/game keyboard routing. Moving a tab keeps its identity. Detaching closes terminal/game display resources but never calls Stop; retained process management belongs to explicit Sessions controls. Wheel events route to the visible terminal or editor under the latest pointer position without changing keyboard focus. Lists receive microui wheel input; a focused game receives wheel only over its image view. Focus loss releases custom scrollbar capture before clearing focus.
